$comment: Hand-curated additions merged over grammar.generated.json by scripts/extract-grammar.mjs. Per entry: `add` (evidence string) creates an entry the source scan cannot see; any other field is merged into the generated entry. Only record what a source or doc actually says — cite it.

normalSizeScale.add: create-ixmap API_REFERENCE.md:116 (schema v1.2 has it under map.scaleParam; flat reads .options() keys indirectly)

glExtensions.$comment: Keys ixmaps-gl reads that ixmaps-flat does not know. Valid with --engine gl; flagged as gl-only with --engine flat (flat ignores them silently).

optionsKeys.splash: ixmaps-gl: false disables the loading splash

dataKeys.remap: ixmaps-gl: per-field value remapping at load

glInternal.$comment: gl-only reads that are NOT grammar: extractor noise (MapLibre style objects / DOM nodes named `style`) or engine internals. Excluded from checks.

gl.note: ixmaps-gl always sizes CHART|BUBBLE by value (valueRadius) and never tests the SIZE flag (ixmaps-gl.js:3208) — behavior WITHOUT SIZE may differ from flat; unverified
ixmaps-gl aggregates as a per-record COUNT whenever binding.size is unset (ixmaps-gl.js:3802) and never tests the COUNT flag itself
ixmaps-gl accepts this only as inline .data({obj}) — any obj whose type is not topojson/geojson is read as a row table (ixmaps-gl.js:403); URL loads support only csv/topojson/geojson
